hidemodded.configuration.title: HideModded Configuration
hidemodded.configuration.hideModded.tool: Hides the asterisk in the title bar and '(Modded)' in the main menu.
Hides the mod counter (e.g. '367 mods loaded') from the main menu branding.
hidemodded.configuration.hideAllBranding: Hides all NeoForge branding lines in the main menu, showing only vanilla Minecraft text.
